name: How long does a general contractor project usually take from start to finish?

mainEntity.name: How long does a general contractor project usually take from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard bathroom remodel typically takes three to six weeks, while full kitchens and basement build-outs usually run between six to twelve weeks or more. Timeline variability often stems from custom material lead times—such as semi-custom cabinetry or specialty tile—as well as unexpected discoveries behind walls during demolition. Lead contractors manage this timeline by pre-ordering materials prior to demo day and coordinating plumbing and electrical sub-trades well ahead of their installation dates, preventing common idle periods on the jobsite.
acceptedAnswer.description: Bathrooms typically take 3 to 6 weeks, while kitchens and basements require 6 to 12 weeks, depending on material lead times and mechanical trade schedules.
